title: Super Cute!
text: Super Cute!. These fall beverage decorative pieces are super cute! I can't wait to put them in my fall themed tiered tray! They are a little smaller than a real coffee beverage you would get at SB, which makes it a good size for the trays. The faux foam is soft but solid. The cups are decorated differently so you could definitely use both of them on the same tray. I have ordered similar ones for different themes for a much higher price, so getting a pair of them is a deal!
